paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of CUBE-easy with a solution validator across different rounds of conversation, comparing binary and detailed feedback types. The x-axis represents the 'Round of Conversation', with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 5, and tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis represents 'Accuracy (%)', also on a linear scale, ranging from 10 to 25, with tick labels at every 5 units. Two lines are shown in the plot: the orange line, representing 'Binary' feedback, starts at approximately 10% accuracy at round 1 and increases to around 24% at round 5, with a steady upward trend; the blue line, representing 'Detailed' feedback, also begins at about 10% at round 1 and rises to roughly 28% at round 5, showing a similar upward trend but with a slightly higher accuracy than the binary feedback line from round 2 onwards.
